cases.title: Newmark rigid block: Cape Mendocino 1992 Petrolia 000 record (Δt 0.02 s, ac 0.1 g, normal polarity)
cases.expected_basis: SLAMMER starts and stops sliding at sample points, whereas this program solves the exact start and stop times between samples, giving a result about 1.2% lower; after the record is linearly refined by a factor of 50, SLAMMER converges to this value (difference < 2×10⁻⁵); an independent piecewise analytical integration in Python gives 34.97031795
cases.tolerance_basis: unit-test tolerance (±10⁻⁶ cm), relaxed to ±10⁻⁵ cm in this report
cases.source: Output of RigidBlock in the official USGS SLAMMER program (Techniques and Methods 12-B1 ver. 1.1); the record is taken from the strong-motion records distributed with SLAMMER
cases.note: The cause of the difference between the original SLAMMER value of 35.40369026 cm and this program has been verified with the refined record; the check uses this program's piecewise analytical value of 34.97031795
cases.title_zh: Newmark 剛性塊體：Cape Mendocino 1992 Petrolia 000 紀錄（Δt 0.02 s、ac 0.1 g、正向）

cases.title: Jibson (2007) ac/amax regression equation (ac 0.02 g, amax 0.5 g)

cases.note: The regression has a standard deviation of 0.510 log units, so ±1σ spans about one order of magnitude; not recommended for site-specific design (Jibson 2007 abstract)
